library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: librealsense2 wraps the Intel RealSense SDK and talks to a physical USB depth camera. No such camera is attached in CI, so tests should exercise device-independent API surface (e.g. rs2::context()/device enumeration returning an empty list, pipeline/config object construction, error-path handling) rather than actual streaming/capture, which cannot run headlessly. Do not add Docker-based device emulation — no RealSense camera emulator image exists or would expose a real USB device to a container.
risks: If librealsense2-platform does not bundle binaries for the CI runner's OS/arch, native loading will still fail even with the dependency added — verify via local Gradle run before relying on this.
Coverage will necessarily be low since the majority of the SDK's functionality requires an attached camera; this is inherent to the library, not a setup gap.
